title: Open pipeline
definition: Sum of open opportunity value at the reporting date.
null_behavior: Zero for covered regions with no eligible activity; missing coverage blocks release.
caveats: Account region/owner at snapshot date; potential value, not a commitment.

title: Net bookings
definition: Signed contract booking events plus signed amendment deltas.
null_behavior: Zero for covered regions with no eligible activity; missing coverage blocks release.
additivity: Additive across disjoint dates and accounts.
caveats: Uses booking events, not won CRM amounts; one-off and recurring commitments are included.

title: Net invoiced
definition: Invoice lines plus negative credit lines.
null_behavior: Zero for covered regions with no eligible activity; missing coverage blocks release.
additivity: Additive across disjoint dates and accounts.
caveats: Not recognized revenue. Credit timing can differ from contract amendments.

title: Cash received
definition: Cash allocations to the invoices included in the supplied source.
null_behavior: Zero for covered regions with no eligible activity; missing coverage blocks release.
additivity: Additive across disjoint dates and accounts.
caveats: Allocated cash only; not bank balance. Unallocated receipts, FX and refunds are outside scope.

title: Period-end ARR
definition: Annualized eligible recurring contract fee at month end.
filters: Recurring, not trial; start inclusive and end exclusive
null_behavior: Zero for covered regions with no eligible activity; missing coverage blocks release.
additivity: Additive across accounts, not across month-end balances.
caveats: Policy 1 includes past-due contracts; annualization is fee times 12 divided by billing months. Not recognized revenue.

title: 30-day opportunity-cohort win rate
definition: Mature opportunities first won within 30 days of creation divided by mature created opportunities.
time_basis: Creation in quarter; 30-day observation window complete by report end
filters: Exclude immature opportunities from both numerator and denominator
null_behavior: Null when mature denominator is zero; immature count is exposed.
additivity: Recompute from summed wins and mature opportunities; never average rates.
caveats: Region is at creation, not current ownership. First win is used; subsequent reopenings are outside this model. March immature rows remain visible.

title: Period-end ARR
definition: Annualized eligible recurring contract fee at month end.
filters: Recurring, not trial; start inclusive and end exclusive; exclude past_due=1
null_behavior: Zero for covered regions with no eligible activity; missing coverage blocks release.
additivity: Additive across accounts, not across month-end balances.
caveats: Policy 2 excludes past-due contracts. This is a definition change, not a source correction. No accounting compliance claim.
